title: Forgeon
claim: Product Hunt: Forgeon — Create, publish, and experience interactive stories
why_good: A platform to create, publish and play AI interactive stories — rides the interactive-fiction + AI wave with a creator-economy angle.
value: Creator platform: subscriptions + a marketplace/rev-share on published stories; AI lowers the authoring bar.
risk: Interactive fiction is a passionate but small market; AI Dungeon and character apps already compete for it.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
